correctness.rationale: The final assertion is for exactly the eight length-three binary-word vertices and fourteen nonloop shift-register arcs, faces being directed acyclic arc sets with indegree at most one at every target. Independently generated all 2^14 masks: precisely 2,186 nonempty faces with f-vector (14,84,280,560,672,448,128), 132 facets (four size 6, 128 size 7). Reconstructed indexed greedy matching: 1,091 pairs and critical faces 0x1 (dimension 0), 0x348a (dimension 5), 0x2cd2 and 0x32cc (dimension 6); independent Kahn traversal visits all 2,186 vertices across all 10,192 oriented Hasse incidences. Direct signed elimination of matched faces gives zero integral 6-to-5 Morse boundary for both critical 6-cells, seven cancellations apiece. Thus CW model has one 0-cell, one 5-cell, two 6-cells, trivial attaching degree in pi_5(S^5)=Z, hence S^5 ∨ S^6 ∨ S^6, not just homology. The fetched verifier gives a separate ordinary boundary rank calculation and exact rational complement action (H6 matrix swaps two top generators, H5 Lefschetz trace -1); checked program algorithm and signed conventions, no nonfinite extrapolation.
